label.fa: ضایعات التهابی روزاسه — یک بار در روز روی صورت
label.en: Inflammatory lesions of rosacea — once daily to the face

reason.fa: یک بار در روز به اندازه یک نخود برای هر ناحیه (پیشانی، چانه، بینی، هر گونه)؛ لایه نازک، دور از چشم و لب.
reason.en: Once daily, a pea-sized amount for each area (forehead, chin, nose, each cheek); thin layer, away from eyes and lips.

text.fa: برچسب خطر مشخصی برای بارداری ذکر نکرده یا داده کافی ندارد؛ فقط در صورت لزوم و با نظر پزشک.
text.en: Label states no clear risk or has limited data; use only if needed, under medical advice.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary The available data on the use of ivermectin, including SOOLANTRA cream, in pregnant women are insufficient to establish a drug- associated risk of major birth defects, miscarriage, or adverse maternal or fetal outcomes.

text.fa: برچسب: در شیردهی با احتیاط؛ متن برچسب را ببینید.
text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary The presence of ivermectin in human milk following topical administration of ivermectin has not been evaluated.

text.fa: برچسب: ایمنی و اثربخشی در کودکان ثابت نشده است.
text.en: Label: safety and effectiveness in children have not been established.

pediatric.quote: Safety and effectiveness of SOOLANTRA cream in pediatric patients have not been established.

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: Of the 1371 subjects in the two pivotal clinical studies of SOOLANTRA cream, 170 (12.4%) were 65 and over, while 37 (2.7%) were 75 and over.
